# Sky News

> > Sky News delivers breaking news, analysis, and comprehensive weather forecasts across the UK and worldwide.

Sky News is a leading British news organization providing 24-hour news coverage, in-depth reporting, and weather services. The platform covers major UK cities including London, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Manchester, Belfast, and Cardiff, as well as international locations.

## Key Topics

- Sky News
- UK Weather Forecasts
- 5-Day Weather Forecast
- London
- Birmingham
- Edinburgh
- Manchester
- Belfast
- Cardiff
- United Kingdom
- Weather Warnings
- Temperature and Wind Data
- Location-Based Weather
- International Weather

## Weather Services

- [Local & Worldwide 5-Day Weather Forecasts](https://news.sky.com/weather): 5-day weather forecasts for UK and worldwide locations with warnings, temperature, wind data, and customizable location search
